WITH closure_calls AS (
  SELECT site_id, conversation_id, is_abandoned
  FROM `fennmoor-dw.dw_contact_center.fct_calls`
  WHERE is_account_closure_call
    AND conversation_date BETWEEN '2025-06-30' AND '2026-06-30'
)
SELECT
  s.site_id,
  s.site_name,
  COUNT(c.conversation_id) AS closure_call_count,
  COUNTIF(c.is_abandoned) AS abandoned_call_count,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNTIF(c.is_abandoned), COUNT(c.conversation_id)) AS abandon_rate
FROM `fennmoor-dw.dw_contact_center.dim_cc_site` AS s
LEFT JOIN closure_calls AS c
  ON s.site_id = c.site_id
GROUP BY s.site_id, s.site_name
ORDER BY abandon_rate DESC
